title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Koivun leads 3M Open
items.text: Jackson Koivun leads the 3M Open with a tournament record 25-under par, shooting 5-under 66 on Sunday for his first PGA Tour victory in just his 13th start.

items.headline: Faldo blasts LIV Golf
items.text: Nick Faldo criticized LIV Golf as "a mess," calling shotgun starts a "television nightmare" and warning the league could collapse due to a fail-free guaranteed-money setup.
